Create one finished portfolio project artwork for NUMI, not a webpage or a design proposal. Output 1536x1344 px (8:7 landscape, nearly square). It will sit in a minimal white portfolio grid with title outside, so NO external headline, logo, labels, watermark, or marketing copy. Use the TWO attached authentic Numi screen assets as exact visual sources. First is meal analysis with photographed stuffed red pepper and nutrition tiles; second is purple Numi home with fasting and progress. Preserve the UI structure, text, colors, photo, chart content and app identity as closely as possible. Editorial art direction: two slim dark titanium iPhones, front-facing with almost no perspective, vertically staggered side by side, slight 7 degree outward rotations. Meal screen in front/right, home behind/left. They do not overlap important screen content. Full complete phone silhouettes within the image, approximately 72% of canvas height, excellent breathing room (at least 100px all sides). Matte pale lavender gray background #e9e6f0, visually flat and quiet, no gradient glow, no stage, no pedestal, no additional objects, no geometric decoration. Very subtle short diffused grounding shadows. Lighting broad soft daylight. A calm high-end product design portfolio composition rather than an advertisement. The two phones should form one centered balanced composition filling about 75% width. Sharp screen details. Do not invent more UI, notifications, badges or screen contents.
